properties.name: app.api.version
properties.description: API version used as path segment prefix e.g. v1

properties.name: app.jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret key used to sign JWT tokens. Must be at least 32 characters.

properties.name: app.jwt.expiration-ms
properties.description: JWT token expiration time in milliseconds. Default 7 days = 604800000.

properties.name: spring.mvc.apiversion.enabled
properties.description: Enables Spring Boot 4 native API versioning support.
